name: Mars: Scarlet Horizons under Charcoal Darkness
source:
An energy breakthrough has opened space for humanity, and the first explorers are leaving Earth on a journey to settle on Mars. No journey is without danger, and our settlers will experience it. Will our settlers overcome Mars's challenges and return to Earth?

You play as Joe Smith (renamable), the mission engineer, veteran astronaut, and a billionaire thanks to co-creating the breakthrough energy source. You are part of the first mission team traveling to Mars. You will discover how the harshness of the Martian surface reshapes your relationships with your crewmates. 

[From [url=https://justaaronart.itch.io/mars-shcd]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
能源突破为人类开辟了太空，第一批探险家正在离开地球踏上火星定居之旅。任何旅程都充满危险，我们的定居者将会经历这些危险。我们的定居者会克服火星的挑战并返回地球吗？

你扮演乔·史密斯（可重命名），任务工程师、经验丰富的宇航员和因共同创造突破性能源而成为亿万富翁。你是第一个前往火星的任务团队的成员。你将发现火星表面的严酷环境如何重塑你与船员的关系。

[来自[url=https://justaaronart.itch.io/mars-shcd]Itch.io[/url]]
